meta.title: BD-LawAssist
meta.description: Legal research for Bangladesh law: ask questions, verify sections, analyse case documents.

home.title: Bangladesh law, in plain words
home.subtitle: Answers to legal questions, every claim cited to the statute text.
home.apiChecking: Checking the connection to the server…
home.apiUp: {count, plural, one {# Act} other {# Acts}} in the law library.

assistant.title: Legal assistant
assistant.body: Ask a question and get an answer cited to verified sections.

library.title: Law library
library.body: Find Acts and sections and see their amendment history.

cases.title: Cases
cases.body: Scan an FIR and see its sections and Schedule II details.

home.disclaimer: This is legal information, not legal advice. Talk to a lawyer before an important decision.
